title: String Raw Values & Case Names
hints: An enum can have `String` raw values different from its case names.
jsBridge: `String` raw values default to the case name (`case small` means `"small"`), like TS string enums but without typing the name twice. `"\(Size.large)"` prints the **case name**, not the raw value, a common surprise.
